source.title: ClaimCrawl synthetic design brief
limitations: Exact interfaces, execution order, algorithm internals, inputs, and outputs are intentionally omitted.

intent.reader_question: How are acquisition, prioritization, and coverage tracking separated?
intent.five_second_message: Candidate acquisition, candidate prioritization, and explored-scope recording are separate responsibilities.
intent.claim_boundary: Do not imply verified performance gains, exact interfaces, a coverage-feedback loop, or guaranteed coverage.

claims.text: The crawler acquires candidates and the selector prioritizes candidates.
claims.evidence: The brief explicitly assigns candidate acquisition to the crawler and candidate prioritization to the selector.

claims.text: The coverage controller records explored scope.
claims.evidence: The brief explicitly assigns explored-scope recording to the coverage controller.

nice_to_show: a grouped boundary for the three responsibilities
must_not_show: exact interfaces beyond the high-level candidate handoff
external modules absent from the brief

panels.title: Separated responsibilities
panels.question: How does each responsibility contribute to the high-level procedure?
panels.visual_form: three responsibility cards with one bounded candidate handoff and no feedback

layout.topology: responsibility map with a bounded left-to-right candidate handoff and no feedback

critical_checks: all three responsibilities appear exactly once
the only arrow is the candidate handoff from crawler to selector
no feedback or exact controller interface appears
